context:
Keep the human focused on product value and system consequences, not generated lines.
Investigate direct sources before questions; show key findings, distinguish facts from assumptions.
Challenge consequential choices when simpler alternatives, cost or evidence suggest a better outcome.
For spikes, investigate feasibility and conditional outcomes instead of assuming implementation.
Use ordinary repository files, local media and portable HTML/SVG; no proprietary artifact APIs.
Keep overview text roughly one screen; link detail. Do not invent decisions, tests or acceptance.
Prototype only: do not change Phoenix application code or external systems.
operationGuidance: Preserve evidence and actual acceptance state; archive is not UAT acceptance or a deployment.
